def compute_max_radii_iterative(centers):
    n = centers.shape[0]
    # wall limits
    wall = np.minimum(np.minimum(centers[:, 0], 1 - centers[:, 0]),
                      np.minimum(centers[:, 1], 1 - centers[:, 1]))
    # pairwise distances
    d = np.linalg.norm(centers[:, None, :] - centers[None, :, :], axis=2)
    np.fill_diagonal(d, np.inf)

    r = wall.copy()
    # Jacobi-style tightening to satisfy r_i + r_j <= d_ij
    for _ in range(80):
        r_new = np.minimum(wall, np.min(d - r[None, :], axis=1))
        r_new = np.maximum(r_new, 0.0)
        if np.max(np.abs(r_new - r)) < 1e-12:
            break
        r = r_new
    return r
